gaps.sentence: The vaccine gives ___ (PROTECT) against three strains.
gaps.explanation: 'Gives protection against' — the noun is required.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: The company has made huge ___ (INVEST) in training.

gaps.explanation: The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is an ___ (IMPRESS) piece of engineering.
gaps.explanation: The bridge impresses people: it is impressive.
